agents.description: Reads the task and decides which specialist agents to bring in.

Reads the newest version of each watched software from GitHub releases, Maven Central or npm, compares it with the version the team runs, and suggests an upgrade ticket for each one that is behind. For a Maven Central or npm package whose version someone gave, it also looks up known vulnerabilities in that version.
capabilities: read Maven Central and npm versions
look up known vulnerabilities in OSV and NVD
compare with the version the team runs
